blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 62-year-old man died after he was struck by lightning during heavy rainfall on Monday afternoon, September 21, in Sitio Mobil, Barangay Dunggo-an, Danao City, Cebu. The victim was identified as alias “Edgar,” a resident of San Antonio, Barangay Guinsay. Earlier, the Danao City Police Station received a call from Cebu Provincial Hospital-Danao City about a patient who was struck by lightning.
